text: [CG 04 35 03 05, ¶ A.2.g.] Coverage under other insurance forms: Other insurance forms may cover breach of fiduciary duty. For example, a Pension & Welfare Fund Fiduciary Responsibility Policy may define “wrongful act” as “a breach of fiduciary duty by the insured in the discharge of duties as respects the Trust or Employee Benefit Plan.” [See Perdue Farms, Inc. v. Travelers Cas. & Sur. Co. of America (4th Cir. 2006) 448 F3d 252, 255—policy covered claims for relief under ERISA] (2) [3:285.2] No coverage for discrimination, etc.: Damages arising out of employment discrimination, wrongful 2 termination or other employment-related practices are specifically excluded. [CG 04 35 03 05, ¶ A.2.j.] (However, EPL coverage may be available for these risks; ¶ 3:170 ff.) (3) [3:285.3] No coverage for bodily injury or property damage: The endorsement specifically excludes “bodily injury,” “property damage” or “personal and advertising injury” liability. [CG 04 35 03 05, ¶ A.2.b.] 2.
